we have presented an ESD design checking framework that is adaptive to full chip ESD rules and can be easily extended to check new rules.

full chip ESD rule checking is possible with a small amount of manual effort and a little bit of automation.
full chip ESD rule checking can be automated and is not limited to a few specific design rule sets.
